name: Secular Humanism
overview: Scripture reveals that secular humanism relies on the vain help of man rather than trusting in God, whose glory all have fallen short of due to sin. The apostle Paul explains that when people reject God, their thinking becomes futile and their hearts darkened. True service and salvation come only through presenting ourselves as living sacrifices to God and receiving His grace by faith, not by human effort or the approval of men. This underscores the futility of human-centered philosophies apart from Christ.
